Ruth, I couldn't set up the daily brief. The scheduler refused my request with a gateway authentication error (`gateway cron.list requires credentials`), so nothing is scheduled and no brief will post at 07:45 tomorrow. I haven't posted a test brief either. Someone with gateway access will need to fix the scheduler credentials, or set up the job through the Automations page, and then I can re-create it.

When it's set up, I'd plan the brief this way:
- It covers new messages in #strategic-pod, #strategic-random and #inc-vtg-hartford since the last brief.
- Everyone in #strategic-random (you, Gideon and Nadia) is also in the other two channels, so the brief won't reveal anything they couldn't already see.
- It will leave out money terms and finance documents, such as rates, prices, discounts, contract values and invoices. Those go to Anselm, June and the account owner, so the brief will point to the source channel for them.
